def addN8840 : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m => m
  | n+1, m => addN8840 n m + 1

theorem addN8840_zero_right (n : Nat) : addN8840 n 0 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [addN8840, ih]

theorem addN8840_succ_right (n m : Nat) : addN8840 n (m+1) = addN8840 n m + 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [addN8840, ih]
theorem addN8840_comm (n m : Nat) : addN8840 n m = addN8840 m n :=
A: by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [addN8840, addN8840_zero_right]
  | succ k ih => simp [addN8840, ih, addN8840_succ_right]
